reviews.title: Still great for non dual chamber cases too!
reviews.comment: Bought the 1200 watt variant for my dual chamber case and it was flawless. Now for a family members build, I had to go with it again despite not being a dual chamber case. Quiet, reliable and functional with the easy connector locations and a dedicated fan/usb hub. It’s also a bonus that the cables are not only high quality but have the same appearance as the custom cable extensions people normally buy. The only ever so minor gripe I have if I had to pick one is that the CPU cables are not individually sleeved like the 24 pin and the 12v 2x6 cables
reviews.author: Drew

reviews.title: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Silent, Efficient, and Perfect for High-End Builds!
reviews.comment:
I installed the Lian Li Edge 1000W ATX 3.0 PSU in my build, and it’s easily one of the best power supplies I’ve used. If you need a modern, efficient, and future-proof PSU, this is the one to get!
✅ True ATX 3.0 & PCIe 5.1 Support – Handles next-gen GPUs with full 12VHPWR compatibility—perfect for future upgrades.
✅ 1000W of Clean, Stable Power – Plenty of headroom for my Core Ultra 265K CPU + RTX 4060 Ti (soon to be 5070 Ti)—runs flawlessly!
✅ Whisper-Quiet Operation – Zero noise at idle thanks to its smart fan curve, and even under load, it stays nearly silent.
✅ L-Shape Design & USB Hub Feature – The L-shaped connectors work perfectly for my Corsair dual-chamber case setup, and the built-in USB headers are a huge plus for cable management.
✅ Fully Modular & Easy Cable Management – High-quality cables, and being fully modular means zero clutter in my build.
💡 Pro Tip: If you’re using a dual-chamber case like the Corsair 6500X, this PSU fits perfectly without bulky cables ruining your clean setup!
🏆 Final Verdict: Future-proof, efficient, and whisper-quiet. Easily one of the best 1000W PSUs for modern builds—highly recommended!
💯 Rating: 5/5 – Absolute Beast of a PSU! 🚀🔥

reviews.title: Dope
reviews.comment: Really neat and cool power supply, it's worth it for an all white build. The hub is really useful so there aren't too many cables on the front, which helps with management. Its quiet and the installation was easy. I recommend it
reviews.author: Ariel san elias V

reviews.title: Amazing power supply with an added fan hub?! Yes please
reviews.comment:
Love this power supply. I was going with an all white build and this fit it perfectly. I did pair it with a lian li case so the ease of putting that in the case and building with it was amazing. This is a game changer for power supply’s. Not only are the ports super accessible but this particular power supply comes with an added fan hub. Which really helped me out for adding extra fans etc. it’s a beast of a power supply and just the added fan headers and ports alone makes this a no brainer as well. The cables that come with this power supply are white and well made and feel very nice. So regardless if you add your own cable extensions or leave how it is your build will honestly look flawless! 10/10 for me.
Don’t mind the cable management. Since pc was put together and these pics were taken the cable management was changed.
reviews.author: Bmp89

reviews.title: It's functional and that little hub is actually quite useful
reviews.comment: I was a little skeptical about this PSU, but I'm not now. That built in or remote placeable USB and fan hub is actually useful. Having the power ports on that lower panel area also was easier to plug in and out and honestly having the single 12+4 Nvidia GPU plug/cable, super plus. That alone cleaned up my aesthetics from the 4 single each for the adapter that came with my 4090.
